environment.description: Same service deployed behind an internal NLB in AWS VPC subnet 10.200.0.0/24. The NLB target group has a health check on /health but no application-layer filtering. Access is controlled by VPC Security Group sg-0a3f8e2c1b (inbound rule: TCP/8443 from 10.128.16.0/22 only — the NOC management VLAN). Additionally, the VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering except to the shared-services VPC (10.128.0.0/16) which itself has NACLs restricting egress from 10.128.16.0/22 to only the NLB subnet. The 10.128.16.0/22 range contains exactly 14 hardened jump hosts running CyberArk PSM with session recording, MFA-gated RDP/SSH access, and no general-purpose browser or scripting capability beyond approved configuration management workflows.

config.source_hosts: 14 CyberArk PSM jump hosts in 10.128.16.0/22, session-recorded, MFA-gated, no arbitrary script execution
config.flow_logs: enabled, sent to CloudWatch Logs with 1-minute aggregation
